title: Service lifecycle
description: System services and Podman containers by host and unit. Received journal events include explicit backup/deployment stop/start cycles; starts include initial startup. Counts cover the selected range and can undercount during telemetry outages or outside Loki retention. Automatic retry counters are supporting scrape-based context, not a count of manual restarts.

panels.title: Starts (incl. initial)
panels.description: Completed systemd start jobs, including initial starts, manual restarts and automatic retries. Not a restart-only count.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="host-agent",host_name=~"${host:regex}"} | json unit="UNIT", event="MESSAGE_ID", pid="_PID" | __error__="" | pid="1" | unit=~`${service:raw}` | event="39f53479d3a045ac8e11786248231fbf" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stops
panels.description: Completed systemd stop jobs, including explicit backup/deployment interruptions. A crash can emit a failure without a completed stop job; inspect the event timeline too.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="host-agent",host_name=~"${host:regex}"} | json unit="UNIT", event="MESSAGE_ID", pid="_PID" | __error__="" | pid="1" | unit=~`${service:raw}` | event="9d1aaa27d60140bd96365438aad20286" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Unit failure-result events, including crashes. Uses systemd's failure-result ID, not just failed start jobs.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="host-agent",host_name=~"${host:regex}"} | json unit="UNIT", event="MESSAGE_ID", pid="_PID" | __error__="" | pid="1" | unit=~`${service:raw}` | event="d9b373ed55a64feb8242e02dbe79a49c" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Retries scheduled
panels.description: Received systemd restart-scheduled events. Explicit stop/start cycles do not increment this count. A scheduled retry is not proof of a successful restart.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="host-agent",host_name=~"${host:regex}"} | json unit="UNIT", event="MESSAGE_ID", pid="_PID" | __error__="" | pid="1" | unit=~`${service:raw}` | event="5eb03494b6584870a536b337290809b3" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Automatic retry counters · sampled
panels.description: systemd NRestarts sampled by node exporter. Resets on explicit restarts/host reboot; short-lived changes between scrapes may be missed. Use journal counts and events above/below for manual stop/start cycles and selected-range counts.

panels.title: Lifecycle events · newest first
panels.description: Structured system-manager events only (PID 1). Filter by host/service above to correlate backup or deployment stop/start cycles. Ordinary application messages mentioning Started are not counted.

targets.expr: {service_name="host-agent",host_name=~"${host:regex}"} | json unit="UNIT", event="MESSAGE_ID", message="MESSAGE", pid="_PID" | __error__="" | pid="1" | unit=~`${service:raw}` | event=~"39f53479d3a045ac8e11786248231fbf|9d1aaa27d60140bd96365438aad20286|d9b373ed55a64feb8242e02dbe79a49c|5eb03494b6584870a536b337290809b3" | line_format `{{.host_name}} · {{.unit}} · {{.message}}`
